thread:
sam: Quick sync  preparing internal note + runbook for tomorrow's inference rollout. Need: concise blurb, who owns model pin, deploy window, and clear rollback/rollforward rules.
anya: I can draft the blurb and handle the internal send.
ops-lead: I'll take model pinning and the deploybot flags. Which model version are we shipping?
sam: Shipping model v2.0.0 (quantized) with fallback v1.9.7. Change window 09:00-11:00 PST. Canary 09:10, prod 09:40.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `release/2026-04-02` -> staging @09:00 PST; canary 09:10; prod 09:40. CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: I'm on rotation for 09:00-11:00. Pager handed over to @sre-oncall.
mike: Rollback triggers suggestion: sustained error rate >0.8% for 2m OR p95 latency >2.0s for 5m. Manual rollback also allowed if model eval quality drops on the smoke set.
ops-lead: Agree with those thresholds. For rollforward, require 30m of stable canary metrics and no quality alerts, then 50% for 15m, then 100%.
anya: Blurb draft: "Engine and routing updates to reduce gen latency and cost. Pinned to v2.0.0; automatic fallback to v1.9.7. No customer action needed." Too wordy?
comm: Tighten to: "Routing + engine tweaks to improve latency & cost. Pinned to v2.0.0. No user changes." I'll send at 10:15 internal time if approved.
sam: Good. Add who to ping on rollback in the doc (ops-lead, mike, @sre-oncall).
ops-lead: I'll add deploybot pin entry and a PR. Pin config snippet: ```yaml
pin_version: "v2.0.0"
fallback_versions:
  - "v1.9.7"
canary: 10% for 5m
```
deploy-bot: Canary plan: 0% -> 10% instantly, hold 5m -> 50% over 15m -> 100% if green. Automatic rollback disabled during manual window.
mike: Runbook rollback commands (put at top): ```
# rollback to last known good
deploy-bot rollback release/2026-04-02 --to v1.9.7
# k8s fallback
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=2001
```
sre-oncall: If thresholds hit, I'll declare incident and tag #incidents + @oncall-escalation. Please follow the runbook steps and keep the thread updated.
anya: Published release note + runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/2026-04-02 (contains blurb, rollback cmds, pin matrix, dashboards links).
comm: Internal announce ready. Preview: "Planned infra & routing improvements for inference. Pinned to v2.0.0. Canary 09:10 PST. No customer action required. Internal on-call 09:00-11:00." Send at 10:15?
sam: Approve. Standby rota: ops-lead, mike, @sre-oncall 09:00-11:00.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: 09:01 PST  canary initialized.
mike: Watching metrics now. Dashboards look green.
sre-oncall: Logs look normal so far. Will escalate on threshold breach.
ops-lead: PR with pin pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/changes/950. Added link to runbook.
anya: Sending internal announce at 10:15 now. :email:
sam: Thanks everyone. If we roll back, document RCA and post a follow-up. Otherwise we'll close this at 11:15. :thumbsup:
